firstPlayerRule: Pick a player to go first. Play moves clockwise. In later games, the winner of the previous game goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody volunteers, use the picker to choose who goes first.
clarifications: Each player starts with all pawns in their color START space.
internalEvidence: Fetched the publisher-hosted PDF linked from instructions.hasbro.com/en-us/instruction/sorry-game and extracted its text with pdftotext. Setup says "Pick a player to go first. Movement is clockwise around the board." The winning section adds "If you play again, the winner goes first." The sheet is marked © 2003 Hasbro and item code 00390.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not say how to pick the first player in the first game.
